game.name: Armored Core 4 (Europe)
game.desc: Armored Core 4 is an action game for Xbox 360. At the controls of your mecha, carry out the different missions of the game at 100 km/h, in a futuristic universe that takes up the one of its predecessors. Missiles, energy rifles, swords, a wide range of weapons are at your disposal. A multiplayer mode is also present, for 1 vs 1, 2 vs 2, 4 vs 4, and Battle Royal battles with 4 or 8 players.
